title: CreNum - Edition numerique de la Chronique francaise de Guillaume Cretin
notes: CreNum is the ELAN (Grenoble) digital XML-TEI edition of Guillaume Crétin's Chronique française (ed. Delaissa Berrada, 2020, CC-BY 3.0 for the TEI at data.elan-numerique.fr/textes/oeuvre15.xml), matching the harvest origin 'ÉLAN crenum: Livre_I..V' (five books, 1515 edition). The edition portal research.elan-numerique.fr (page oeuvres/edition/15) did not respond at check time (000), so the live GitLab repo gricad-gitlab.univ-grenoble-alpes.fr/elan/crenum is given as the verified project URL. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the RQ Open Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, deduplicated texts).
institution: ELAN / UMR Litt&Arts (CNRS / Universite Grenoble Alpes)
